name: Jumping Jack
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms resting relaxed at your sides.
Jump both feet out wide to the sides while simultaneously sweeping your arms overhead until your hands nearly touch.
Jump immediately back to bring your feet together as you lower your arms back to your sides.
Continue moving in a crisp, continuous rhythm for the target duration.
tips: Land lightly on the balls of your feet with slightly soft knees to cushion the impact.
Keep your core lightly braced and avoid letting your knees cave inward when jumping out wide.
